repo.description:
### Summary

The `openresty-vhosts` plugin copies files from an app's `openresty/http-includes/` git repository directory to the host and then interpolates their filenames, unescaped, into a single-quoted shell string that is later parsed by eval. A filename containing a single quote breaks the quoting and allows command substitution to execute arbitrary commands on the host as the dokku user during the app's next deploy.

This security issue applies to installations that utilize the openresty proxy plugin and can be exploited by any Dokku user with push access to an application where openresty is the configured proxy.

### Patches

- https://github.com/dokku/dokku/pull/8588
repo.summary: Host RCE via Maliciously Named OpenResty Include Files Injected Through eval
